scope: First reversible production candidate, not yet visually accepted. Original native indexed geometry only; no replacement mesh, new material or tooth edit.

causalDecision.positiveEvidence: Actual R06 jaw/speak native and draw cross-sections share connected existing lower return paths. The crest concentrates a geometric tangent/face-normal turn: center about71.4 degrees; sides jaw about50 degrees and speak about64. Native raw upper=true at these actual lower return crests cannot define motion carrier.
causalDecision.rejectedExplanation: The v=.05 dental-envelope entry gate creates zero observed crossing-edge displacement jump in current jaw/speak. Jaw moves only one upper vertex 0.004990mm; speak moves zero. No dental algorithm modification is justified by this target.
causalDecision.negativeEvidence: Connected inner return and several-mm anchor separation refute a missing-sheet assumption, but do not measure tissue thickness. Existing material diagnostics also do not establish missing bulk.
causalDecision.candidateHypothesis: Spread the turn over nearby existing lower return triangles with bounded positive screened fairing while fixing the lip body, contacts and mouth-width component. Actual new matched images decide whether the visible hard edge improves.

binding.source: Current original solver.topology.geometry fRest/index/csType/l19Oral and top.samples/pairs
binding.graph: Scan every original triangle, deduplicate skin-skin edges, positive rest Euclidean lengths, CSR adjacency; never top.neighbors. Multi-source shortest paths from original upper and lower49 sample groups traverse this full graph.
binding.lower: Lower distance plus1mm must be less than upper distance, gain ramps from1 to3mm difference. No use of native upper tag for carrier.
binding.fixed: Every vertex with v>=-.015, all original49pair IDs, then exactly one original-index neighbor ring of that union. All nonfree vertices remain fixed, including nonskin, upper carrier, mouth corners and far boundaries.
binding.crest: Pure oral=1 with any adjacent oral<1 in the lower negative-v region. Track its actual movement; do not claim this identifies every anatomical crest. Require freeCrestVertices>0 so a binding that misses the measured target cannot run.
binding.fingerprints: Rest/index/free/protection/ownership recorded. Normal geometry identity, references, shape/material authoring and API ownership guards disable stale binding; no posed correction is stored.

fairing.equation: For each selected current position component p: [degree_i/(ell^2*g_i)+sum_j w_ij] delta_i - sum_free_j w_ij delta_j = sum_j w_ij(p_j-p_i), w_ij=1/restLength_ij^2; fixed delta=0. Solve independently for up and front with the identical SPD matrix, then multiply both deltas by the continuous jaw gate.
fairing.input: Actual current positions after original native closure/R05 correction/R06 and dental envelope, immediately before first computeVertexNormals. This is a current shape fairing, not a rest-mesh mutation or a pucker displacement redistribution.
fairing.solver: Diagonal-preconditioned conjugate gradients, max512 iterations/component, actual residual recomputed every iteration; max abs(A*delta-rhs)/diagonal<=0.0001mm and relative L2 residual<=1e-6. Report does not equate residual with solution error or biological precision.
fairing.bounds: Scalar positive source bounds checked without artistic clamping. Entire proposal staged in a separate Float32 array. Max gated 3D proposed displacement must be<=0.6mm; actual quantized displacement<=0.6001mm; mouth-x leakage<=0.0001mm from Float32 storage only.
fairing.triangleGuard: Every original triangle incident to a free vertex is checked after Float32 quantization. Finite nondegenerate area, original-to-proposed normal dot>0 and proposed/original area>=.1 required. This is a local fold/collapse guard, not full collision detection.
fairing.atomicCommit: All solve, finite, scalar-bound, cap, triangle and protected-position checks finish before any native position write. Then only free vertex up/front-derived coordinates are committed. No per-vertex cap or vector normalization.

execution.wrapper: Instance-level outer wrapper around exact existing R06 solver.apply, never global prototype or native text replacement.
execution.stage: Temporarily wrap only geometry.computeVertexNormals. First native call runs staged fairing then original normals; second call runs original normals only. Require exactly2 synchronous calls. Original closure, envelope, strain, microgeometry, final normals/bounds continue.
execution.restoration: Finally restores the exact original computeVertexNormals descriptor and verifies inherited pairs.map/lips iterator identities/descriptors. uninstall restores exact R06 apply descriptor; an intervening owner is an error rather than silently overwritten.
execution.zeroGate: Call inherited R06 directly without normal hook or position writes; last recordsnormalCalls0, no solve, no triangle guard and no comparison counts.
execution.reportCompatibility: Outside evaluation use cornerLip.report to inherit the actual R06/R05/R04 compatibility decision; never edgeLip.report. Inside outer apply R02 temporarily sets microGeometry=.35 while R06 pucker0 bypass is not running. Therefore never call ancestor report in this interval: use original-bound source/authoring/material/API/reference checks and the recorded expected transient micro value. Original R06 evaluator still performs its own inEvaluation guards.
execution.normalInvalidation: Identity, topology, calibration, material or ancestor state changes disable and fall through to inherited native evaluation; no user labels or parameters rewritten.
execution.unexpectedFailure: Throw after exact temporary descriptor restoration and disable candidate. If later inherited stages fail after commit, native update is required after detach; EdgeLip pose/compare/restore recovery is responsible for clearing a partially evaluated frame. Proposal guard failures happen before native writes.
execution.stageCompletionEvidence: last.allOriginalStagesExecuted starts false and becomes true only after the inherited synchronous call returns normally and the required normal stage count has passed (or the original zero-gate bypass returns normally). Failure records do not claim completed stages.

reportContract.binding: freeReturnVertices/freeCrestVertices/crestVertices; global body/nonSkin/contact/protection counts and raw-index fingerprints
reportContract.verificationBoundary: Direct exact flags are at the staged boundary. Independent full native final position SHAs for body/nonskin/49 contact pairs must still match R06 after microgeometry; direct flags do not replace those checks.

localVerification.scope: Synthetic indexed strip crease only: graph binding, nonempty free crest, finite SPD residual, nonzero fairing, body/contact/protected exact,2normal stage lifecycle, half gate, neutral/pucker0 exact, normal identity invalidation fallback, uninstall restoration, transient report isolation, and excessive proposal rejected before position writes. This is not a person-specific visual or biological validation.

remainingRisks: Fairing can shift the crest, reduce opening or soften a useful ridge; the cap and area guard do not make those changes desirable.
The stable lower graph/negative-v domain is an engineering ownership approximation. Unusual anatomy can fail binding and must not reuse another person's weights.
Final surface visibility and tooth occlusion are not inferred from cross-section length. Teeth and the actual declared jaw/speak/pucker inputs must remain identical.
Static supported-pose evidence will not establish arbitrary action mixtures, all animation derivatives, full-volume conservation or whole-mesh contact.
acceptance: Retain only if actual same-person jaw/speak macro+oblique visibly gain a readable continuous lower return without lip/body/contact/teeth regressions; require current neutral and pucker exact and actual archive/half-progress restore. A lower angle or passing technical gate alone is insufficient.
